description: Generate AI-powered test artifacts for a suite using the Wopee.io AI engine. Each call creates one artifact type — call multiple times for different types. Generation order matters: APP_CONTEXT must be generated before user stories, and user stories before test cases. If called out of order, the AI may produce lower quality results. On success, returns confirmation that generation started. Use wopee_fetch_artifact to retrieve the generated content once ready. Do NOT use this to hand-edit existing artifacts — use wopee_update_artifact instead. TEST_CASES runs in UPDATE mode by default: existing test cases keep their steps and run history, and `instructions` says what to add or change. Destructive generations are mode CREATE (replaces the test cases in scope and deletes their steps, runs and code), USER_STORIES_WITH_TEST_CASES (rebuilds every story and test case) and TEST_CASE_STEPS (replaces the steps of the test cases in scope): use them only when the user explicitly asks for that, and scope them with selectedUserStories / selectedTestCases when the user named stories or test cases.

async.description: TEST_CASES and USER_STORIES_WITH_TEST_CASES only. true returns as soon as the generation is queued instead of waiting for it (a large suite can take several minutes); the content is then read later with wopee_fetch_artifact. Default false: wait and return the generated artifact.

instructions.description: What the user asked for, in their words, e.g. 'add a negative test for an expired card'. Passed to the AI engine as the change request; without it, UPDATE removes no test case.

mode.description: TEST_CASES only. UPDATE (default) keeps every existing test case with its steps and run history, and adds or changes test cases around them. CREATE replaces the test cases of the stories in scope — of the whole suite when selectedUserStories is empty — and deletes their steps, run history and Playwright code. Use CREATE only when the user explicitly asks to start over.

selectedTestCases.description: Test case identifiers to limit TEST_CASE_STEPS to, e.g. ['US001:TC002']. Leave empty for every test case in scope. Regenerating steps replaces the steps those test cases have.

selectedUserStories.description: User story ids to limit the generation to, e.g. ['US001', 'US003']. Leave empty for every story in the suite. Used by TEST_CASES and TEST_CASE_STEPS.

suiteUuid.description: UUID of the analysis suite to generate artifacts for. Get this from wopee_create_blank_suite or wopee_fetch_analysis_suites.

type.description: Type of test artifact to generate. One of: APP_CONTEXT, GENERAL_USER_STORIES, USER_STORIES_WITH_TEST_CASES, TEST_CASES, TEST_CASE_STEPS, REUSABLE_TEST_CASES, REUSABLE_TEST_CASE_STEPS. Start with APP_CONTEXT, then generate stories and test cases from it.

name: wopee_generate_artifact
title: Generate test artifacts
